skills.title: Key Nutrients in Food
skills.description: Match nutrients like carbohydrates, protein, fat, vitamins, and minerals to foods that have them. Pick why your body, brain, and muscles need each one.

skills.title: Risks and Safety Online
skills.description: Pick the risks of too much screen time, texting, gaming, and the Internet, like losing sleep or meeting online strangers. Choose smart ways to stay safe.

skills.title: Bullying and Unsafe Behaviour
skills.description: Sort kinds of bullying, including cyberbullying, and other behaviour that is not okay. Pick how it can make someone feel and the best way to respond.

skills.title: What Is in Tobacco and Vapes
skills.description: Match substances like nicotine, tar, and carbon monoxide to tobacco and vaping products and smoke. Pick how each one can hurt your health.

skills.title: Changes at Puberty
skills.description: Sort the body changes that happen at puberty, like growing taller and body odour. Pick feelings and social changes that can come with them.

skills.title: Tracking Eating Habits and Goals
skills.description: Read a simple food log and pick a healthy eating goal that fits Canada's Food Guide, like choosing water or eating more vegetables.

skills.title: Steps for Safe Decisions
skills.description: Put the steps of making a safe choice in order. Use them to pick the safest option when cycling, cooking, or going online.

skills.title: Choosing Not to Smoke or Vape
skills.description: Pick strong ways to say no to smoking and vaping, like giving a reason or changing the topic. Sort what can push a choice, like peer pressure.

skills.title: Hygiene as You Grow
skills.description: Pick the hygiene habits that matter more at puberty, like showering, clean clothes, and using hygiene products. Remember hand washing and tooth care too.

skills.title: Daily Choices for Mind Health
skills.description: Pick everyday choices that help your mind, like sleep, being active, mindfulness, feeling check-ins, and helping others.

skills.title: Healthy Eating Everywhere
skills.description: Pick ways to help people eat healthier at school, arenas, stores, camping, or a friend's house.

skills.title: Effects of Smoke and Vaping
skills.description: Sort short- and long-term effects of smoking and vaping on smokers. Pick how second-hand smoke can hurt people nearby.

skills.title: Managing Stress
skills.description: Pick strategies for stress you can control, and ways to cope with changes you can't, like moving or family stress.
